empty.lead: Register your gym to open its console. Gyms you are invited to will appear here.

restricted.heading: Not available for your role

draft.title: This gym isn’t set up yet

access.title: Your access
access.note: Each action is checked by SimpleFit for this gym. No gym role reads anyone’s private training data.

roles.owner: You own this gym: its details, setup and team, and later its members.
roles.manager: You help run this gym: its details, locations, team and members.
roles.coach: You coach at this gym: your classes and their rosters.
roles.front_desk: You run the front desk: check-ins, bookings and members at the desk.

limited.title: Your dashboard
limited.body: The {role} dashboard isn’t available yet. You can open this gym; its tools arrive with their features.

attendance.title: Bookings & attendance overview
attendance.body: A gym-wide view of bookings and attendance. Each class’s roster and check-ins are in the timetable.

intro.title: Welcome to your gym console
intro.body: A short tour of what works today: your checklist, your gym, the menu and the switcher. About a minute.

intro.resumeBodyUndated: You started it on another device. Tour steps aren’t saved, so it starts from the first step here.
intro.failed: We couldn’t save that. Nothing changed.

completed.title: Introduction finished.
completed.body: It won’t open again on any device. Your checklist keeps following what your gym really does.

dismissed.title: Introduction skipped.
dismissed.body: It won’t open again on any device. Skipping didn’t change your checklist or your gym.

unavailable.title: We couldn’t load your introduction and checklist.
unavailable.body: The console works without them. Nothing was changed.

checklist.title: Your gym’s checklist
checklist.readyBody: Gym identity and location are saved.
checklist.moreBody: These open when their features launch. They aren’t missing steps.
checklist.footnote: Finishing or skipping the introduction doesn’t change this list. Each step ticks itself when your gym really does it, on web and mobile.

create_gym.title: Create your gym
create_gym.completed: Name, type and location are saved
create_gym.available: Finish setup to create your gym

add_class.title: Add your first class
add_class.completed: Your first class is on the timetable
add_class.available: Add a class to your timetable
add_class.coming_later: Comes with classes and the timetable

invite_staff.title: Invite your staff
invite_staff.completed: A staff member accepted an invitation

invite_members.title: Invite members
invite_members.available: Share your join code or invite a member

first_check_in.title: Record a first check-in
first_check_in.available: Check a member in at the desk

skip.title: Skip the introduction?
skip.body: It won’t open again on this or any other device. Your checklist stays exactly as it is: skipping completes nothing.
skip.failed: We couldn’t save that. Nothing changed. Try again.

finishing.title: Finishing…
finishing.body: Saving that you finished the introduction. Nothing else changes.

finishFailed.title: We couldn’t save that
finishFailed.body: The introduction stays open and nothing changed. Try again, or finish later on any device.

confirm.label: End introduction
confirm.title: End the introduction?
confirm.body: It won’t open again on this or any other device. Your checklist stays exactly as it is: ending completes nothing.

checklist.title: Your opening checklist
checklist.body: One step is done: your gym exists. Steps whose tools haven’t launched show as coming later and are never counted as missing.

gym.title: Your gym and your access
gym.body: Name, type and location come straight from your setup. Your access shows what your role can do at this gym, and only at this gym.

menu.title: Tools arrive in this menu
menu.body: Dashboard, members, staff and the timetable work today. The rest are marked Soon and open when they launch. Nothing behind them is half-built.

switcher.title: One account, every role
switcher.body: You’re the owner of {name}. Switch gyms or open your fighter or coach profile here, with no second sign-in. Each gym keeps its own data and its own introduction.

done.title: You know your way around
done.body: Saved for this gym on every device: the introduction won’t open again. Your checklist keeps following what your gym really does.

roles.front_desk: {count, plural, one {# at the front desk} other {# at the front desk}}

roster.heading: Team
roster.alone: Only you so far. Invite coaches and front desk staff to work here with you.

active.title: No active staff
active.body: Invited people appear here once they accept.

ended.title: No one has left
ended.body: People who leave or are removed from this gym appear here.

person.heading: {name}
person.owner: The owner keeps full access. It changes only when ownership is transferred.
person.noActions: Your role doesn’t include changing this person’s access.

owner.line: Everything at this gym, including its setup and team
owner.detail: Runs the gym: its details, location and setup, and the whole team.

manager.line: The gym’s details and location; invites and manages coaches and front desk
manager.detail: Helps run the gym: its details and location, and invites coaches and front desk and changes their roles.

coach.line: Coaches at this gym; sees the gym and its team
coach.detail: Coaches at this gym: the gym’s console and team, and the rosters of the classes they teach.

front_desk.line: Runs the front desk; sees the gym and its team
front_desk.detail: Runs the front desk: the gym’s console and team, class rosters and check-ins.

reference.heading: Roles at this gym
reference.never: No gym role reads anyone’s private training data. A coach role here is not a coaching relationship with anyone, and a person’s own coach profile stays theirs.

invite.lead: We send an invitation to this address. The person joins only after accepting it while signed in with that address.

role.label: Role

leave.title: Leave {gym}?

active.title: No members yet

ended.title: No ended memberships
ended.body: Members who leave or are removed are listed here.

person.heading: About {name}
person.noActions: Only the owner and managers can end a membership.

privacy.heading: The gym can’t see
privacy.body: Email addresses, training logs, weight, goals, coach notes, videos and messages. Members keep these to themselves.
privacy.membership: A membership means this person takes part in your gym. It isn’t a paid plan or a subscription.

requests.heading: Join requests
requests.lead: People who entered your join code and are waiting for your answer.

reject.title: Reject {name}?
reject.body: {name} won’t become a member of {gym}. They can ask again later with a valid join code. Their account isn’t affected.

remove.title: End {name}’s membership?
remove.body: {name} stops being a member of {gym} right away. The membership stays in your history as ended.

keeps.profiles: Their Fighter or Coach profile isn’t changed.
keeps.coaches: Their coaches and training stay as they are.
keeps.gyms: Memberships at other gyms aren’t affected.

remove.done: {name} is no longer a member of {gym}.

invite.title: Invite a member to {gym}
invite.lead: We’ll email an invitation to this address. The person becomes a member only if they accept it.
invite.privacy: An email address alone doesn’t prove who someone is. The person signs in with this address to accept.

pending.title: Invitation pending
pending.body: The invitation for {email} is pending until {expires}.
pending.note: They become a member only after they accept. You can resend or cancel it under Invitations.

unavailable.title: Member invitations aren’t available yet
unavailable.body: Invited people can’t accept member invitations in SimpleFit yet, so they’re switched off. Nothing was created and no email was sent.
unavailable.note: Share your join code instead: people who enter it send you a join request.

invitations.heading: Member invitations
invitations.off: Member invitations aren’t available yet. No invitations can be created or resent; your join code still works.

about.heading: How invitations work
about.body: An invitation is pending for 7 days. A person becomes a member only when they accept it.
about.proof: Accepting needs a SimpleFit account signed in with the invited address. Nobody is added automatically.

invitations.resent: The invitation for {email} is pending again until {expires}.

cancelInvitation.title: Cancel this invitation?
cancelInvitation.body: The link sent to {email} stops working. You can invite this address again later.

settings.readOnly: Only the owner and managers can change this.

code.heading: Join code
code.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the code and copy it yourself.
code.howOn: People who enter this code in SimpleFit send your gym a join request. The code alone doesn’t prove who they are.
code.howOff: Turn it on to give people a code they can use to ask to join.

auto.heading: Approval
auto.label: Approve verified accounts automatically
auto.on: On: people with a completed account and a verified sign-in become members as soon as they enter your code.
auto.off: Off: every join request waits for your answer.
auto.verified: Anyone without a verified sign-in still waits for your answer.

done.rotate: New join code issued. The old code no longer works.
done.disable: Joining by code is off. The old code no longer works.

rotate.title: Issue a new join code?
rotate.body: The current code stops working right away. Share the new code with anyone who hasn’t joined yet.

enable.title: Turn on joining by code?
enable.body: {gym} gets a join code people can use to ask to join.

disable.title: Turn off joining by code?
disable.body: The current code stops working and nobody can ask to join {gym} with a code until you turn it on again. Pending requests stay.

autoOn.title: Approve verified accounts automatically?
autoOn.body: People with a completed SimpleFit account and a verified sign-in will become members of {gym} as soon as they enter your join code, without your review. Everyone else still waits for your answer. You can turn this off at any time.

autoOff.title: Turn off automatic approval?
autoOff.body: Every new join request to {gym} will wait for your answer.

about.heading: About joining
about.code: Front desk can show the code at the desk. Only the owner and managers can issue a new one or turn it off.
about.auto: Automatic approval is off unless you turn it on, and it never applies to people without a verified sign-in.

venues.note: Classes already held in a venue keep naming it after it’s deactivated.

deactivateVenue.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivateVenue.body: It will take no new classes, and this can’t be undone. Classes already held there keep naming it. A venue with classes still to come can’t be deactivated.

archiveTemplate.title: Archive {title}?
archiveTemplate.body: It will take no new classes, and this can’t be undone. Classes and series already scheduled from it stay exactly as they are.
